rows.name: Lune River
rows.description: On Cockerham Point and Plover Scar Rock, while 8 ft. water

rows.name: Clark Wharf Spit Lt.-Ves.
rows.description: Also shows a bright light, while 8 ft. Fog Bell every 20 secs.

rows.name: Morecambe Harbour
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. Red and green lights 3. Two red lights 4. One blue and red lt.
rows.description: 1. At extremity of W. or stone pier. 2. At pier heads, green to westward, red to northward 3. One 130 yds. from end of stone pier, in line with another 1 cable from end of wooden jetty, lead over ba. 4. Fr m end of promenade pier, blue seaward, red to harbour.

rows.name: Morecambe Bay Lt.-Ves.
rows.description: In 12 fms.; flash ev. ½ min. Fog-trumpet, 1 blast every 2 minutes. Warning-gun.

rows.name: WALNEY ISLAND
rows.character: One br. rev. lt., 1 min. One red fixed light
rows.description: On the S. point. In one, N.W. by W. ¾ W., 440 yds. apart. A red light also on Railway Viaduct; and a bright light on Piel Pier

rows.name: Piel Harbour
rows.character: 1. One fixed bright lt. 2. One red and br. lt.
rows.description: 1. On Michel Scar 2. Bright to S.S.E. and N.W. in direction of channel

rows.name: Barrow
rows.character: 1. One fixed light 2. One red light 3. One flashing lt.
rows.description: 1. On E. side of ch nnel to Barrow, 1 mile N.W. of Piel pier light 2. At dock entrance, 2 hours before to 2 hours after high water 3. From chimney of Hindpool Ironworks, N. of Barrow.

rows.name: ST. BEES HEAD
rows.description: A white tower, 55 ft. high

rows.name: Whitehaven
rows.character: 1. One rev. lt. 2 min. 2. Two fixed lights
rows.description: 1. A white tower, 37 ft. high, on W. pier-head. 2. Blue lt. on N. pier; red lt. on Old Quay, while 9 ft., in entrance; red flag by day

rows.name: Harrington Tide Light
rows.description: On the pier-head, while 8 ft. water. Red drum while 8 feet

rows.name: Workington Tide Lights
rows.character: 1. Two bright fix. lts. 2. Two green lights
rows.description: 1. On the ends of St. John's & Wooden piers, E. and W., while 8 ft. water 2. Two green lts. in one E.S.E. lead in

rows.name: Maryport
rows.character: One br., one tide light One green, one red light
rows.description: Fixed light on outer pier-head. Tide light, while 8 ft., on inner pier. Red light on starboard side, and green light on North Tongue

rows.name: Solway Lightvessel
rows.description: In 4½ fathoms in Robin Rigg Channel. Black ball; a bell in fogs

rows.name: Lee Scar
rows.description: On piles on the rocks. A bell in fogs

rows.name: Skinburness
rows.description: A white building, 32 ft. high, on Cott or Silloth Point

rows.name: Carlisle Port Tide Light
rows.description: A lamp on the pier-head

rows.name: POINT OF AYRE
rows.character: A rev. lt., br. and red, alternately
rows.description: A stone tower, 99 ft. high, [?] mile S.W. of the point; flash every minute

rows.name: Peel Harbour
rows.character: One fixed red light One fixed light
rows.description: Red light on East side of entrance. Bright lt. on end of breakwater

rows.name: Port Erin
rows.description: On end of new breakwater

rows.name: CHICKEN ROCK
rows.description: Granite tower 143 ft. high, [?] mile W. from S. extremity of Calf of Man. Fog-bell every ½ minute
